### LumiRaffe

Bring a touch of the savanna to your desk with this minimalist Giraffe Lamp! 🦒

This playful, sleek giraffe-shaped desk lamp is perfect for kids' rooms, nurseries, or anyone who loves unique and quirky home decor. Its smooth, organic curves make it a beautiful display piece even when the light is turned off.

The head of the giraffe is specifically designed to house the light source, turning this friendly animal into a fully functional reading or ambient lamp.

Hardware & Assembly Instructions:

* Hardware Required: This model is designed to be used specifically with the original Bambu Lab LED Lamp Kit (MH001).
* First Assembly: You can assemble the lamp piece by piece, carefully routing the USB cable through each part as you build it. For a permanent and more stable result, the parts can be glued together.

 

* ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Please follow the sequence of photos for the assembly instructions. When installing the LED module, ensure that the power button is always facing upwards, exactly as shown in the photos.
* Replacing the light (if glued): If you decide to glue the model and need to replace the LED kit in the future, don't worry! Simply tie a piece of string to the USB plug of the old light before pulling it out. You can then use this string to gently pull the new cable through the neck, always making sure the new power button stays facing upwards.

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: LumiRaffe - Giraffe Lamp
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 2
- Infill: 8%
- Filament: PLA (#18C241)
